title: Ibhotwe leGlasi enesibuko
intro: Khawucinge ngelizwe elikude lobutyebi nobuhle apho ilanga linqulwa khona endaweni yoMdali walo. Ileta ifika inesibhengezo esingenakutyeshelwa, kwaye uhambo luqala ukuya enkundleni enkulu kunayo nayiphi na eyakha yabonwa ngaphambili. Apho, inkohliso iya kutyhilwa ngumgangatho okhohlisa amehlo, kwaye umzuzu wokucaca uya kutshintsha yonke into.
clues: Ndalawula ilizwe elichumayo elinabantu balo baqubuda elangeni endaweni ka-Allah.
Ndifumene ileta ehloniphekileyo endibiza ukuba ndingaziphakamisi kodwa ndizithobe ku-Allah.
Ndibuzise kumasipala wam ndaza ndakhetha idiplomacy kuqala, ndathumela isipho ukuvavanya umntu othumeleyo.
Ndafika eSulayman, ndaza ndanikwa itrone yam ndizifihlile ukuze kuvavanywe ukuqatshelwa kwam.
Ndingene kwibhotwe eliphakamileyo elalinomgangatho weglasi ogudileyo endandicinga ukuba ngamanzi anzulu.
Ndavakalisa ukuzithoba kwam kuSulayman kuAllah, iNkosi yehlabathi.

trial.label: Uvavanyo/Isiganeko
options: Ndihlaselwe kukugula iminyaka emininzi nokulahlekelwa lusapho
Wayalelwa ukuba anikele ngomntwana wakhe amthandayo ephupheni
Ivavanywa yitrone efihliweyo kunye nebhotwe leglasi
Waphoswa emlilweni ovuthayo ngenxa yokuqhekeza izithixo

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
